Little by little, things began to change. Lily believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Lily will take part in a football match in January. For example, good hygiene stops the spread of disease.

On Saturday evenings, Lily reviews the notes from class. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. People around Lily often share different ideas about the swimming pool. Add a spoonful of bouillon to the soup.

At first, Lily found it difficult to keep the habit. Sam advised Lily to try cooking as a new hobby. The swimming pool looked quieter than usual that evening. The theorist published a new book on learning.

There are always more possibilities than we expect. Lily thanked Sam for the honest advice. The morning playground has become an important part of daily life. Best of all, she served tiny iced petit fours after afternoon tea.
Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Lily is saving money to buy a ticket to Tokyo. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right.
